description: Add a footnote anchored to a paragraph. Optionally position the reference after specific text using after_text. Note: [^N] markers in read_file output are display-only and not part of the editable text used by replace_text. Surface: revisionable + package-mutation — the footnote reference and note text are tracked (w:ins), while footnote-part creation and registration are recorded in the save report non-revision change manifest.

after_text.description: Text after which to insert the footnote reference. If omitted, appends at end of paragraph.

file_path.description: Path to the DOCX or ODT file.

target_paragraph_id.description: Paragraph ID to anchor the footnote to.

name: add_footnote
